convention: Local Euler angles in degrees in the parent's frame, R = Rz(rz) Ry(ry) Rx(rx); +Z up, mech faces -Y, left side = +X. Zero = rest (arms hanging). Pitch rx: negative swings a hanging limb's tip forward/up. root_pos is a translation added to the rest root; com and feet are world positions in metres with the root at the origin.
